_comment: Model registry for the fully local backend (skills/jev-browser/bin/jev-local.mjs). Swapping models is a data edit: point "default" at another id, or pick one per run with --model-name <id>. Every entry needs file (bare .gguf filename, downloaded into ~/.jev-browser/models), url (https resolve URL), bytes (exact size), label (shown by --list-models and doctor).
